question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing left back, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing benchwarmer, Eve is playing right back, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Finally, Fred and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) left back
(C) sweeper
(D) benchwarmer
(E) right back
(F) right midfielder
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: left midfielder | left back | sweeper | benchwarmer | right back | right midfielder | goalkeeper
1. Bob ↔ Claire: left midfielder | sweeper | left back | benchwarmer | right back | right midfielder | goalkeeper
2. Alice ↔ Fred: right midfielder | sweeper | left back | benchwarmer | right back | left midfielder | goalkeeper
3. Dave ↔ Claire: right midfielder | sweeper | benchwarmer | left back | right back | left midfielder | goalkeeper
4. Claire ↔ Fred: right midfielder | sweeper | left midfielder | left back | right back | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
5. Bob ↔ Dave: right midfielder | left back | left midfielder | sweeper | right back | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
6. Dave ↔ Bob: right midfielder | sweeper | left midfielder | left back | right back | benchwarmer | goalkeeper
7. Fred ↔ Claire: right midfielder | sweeper | benchwarmer | left back | right back | left midfielder | goalkeeper
Alice's final position is right midfielder, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
